post.title: Americans plan to spend $920M on pet Halloween costumes
post.ig:
Americans will spend $920 million dressing up their pets.

NRF expects record Halloween spending of $13.5 billion in 2026, up from $8.05 billion in 2020.
Costumes $4.4B, decorations $4.3B, candy $4.1B, cards $0.8B. $115.14 per person.
Spirit Halloween opens more than 1,500 temporary pop-up stores.
